description: Get expanded property crime details from the FBI (Supplemental Return / Return A data). Provides additional breakdowns beyond summarized counts: value of stolen/recovered property, type of property, premises involved. Available for burglary (NB), larceny (NL), motor vehicle theft (NMVT), and robbery (NROB).

ori.description: Agency ORI code for agency-level data

state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation for state-level data
